scope.flow: Router/Core swap transaction execution without a user-specified deadline
scope.environment: DeFi DEX Router and underlying Core contract

statements.text: The Router and underlying Core contracts do not allow users to specify a deadline for their swap transactions.
The Router's only protections are slippage parameters calculatedAmountThreshold and sqrtRatioLimit, which guard price movements relative to execution time but not the time value of the trade.
A user submits a swap transaction to the Router without a deadline.
The transaction is held by a validator or remains in the mempool for an extended period.
The held transaction is executed when market conditions have changed unfavorably for the user.
Absence of a deadline parameter means nothing prevents execution after a significant delay, so slippage limits alone cannot protect against the time value of the trade or changed external factors.
Users may have their transactions executed at unexpected times.
Users may suffer unwanted trades or loss of opportunity, particularly during periods of high network congestion or volatility.
Swap transactions should be bound by a user-specified deadline so they cannot be executed after a significant delay once market conditions have changed unfavorably.

ambiguities: Report does not state a concrete numeric delay bound or deadline value.
Report does not establish that a delayed execution actually occurred; holding and later execution are described as possible.
No specific actor authorization or permissionless-call claim is made; validator/mempool holding is generic.
